{@body const [framework,setFramework]=DIL.useState("react")}
{@body const [scenario,setScenario]=DIL.useState("chatbot")}
{@body const [features,setFeatures]=DIL.useState(["virtual"])}
{@body const [details,setDetails]=DIL.useState("")}
<box border radius="2xl" padding={4} gap={3}>
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    <title>Frontend Task Builder</title>
    <badge>Form + Action</badge>
  </row>
  <box gap={1}>
    <label>技术框架</label>
    <radio-group direction="row" value={framework} onChange={setFramework}>
      <radio value="react">React</radio>
      <radio value="vue">Vue</radio>
      <radio value="vanilla">原生 JS</radio>
    </radio-group>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <label>开发场景</label>
    <select block value={scenario} onChange={setScenario} options={[{value:"chatbot",label:"Chatbot 消息列表"},{value:"dashboard",label:"数据分析 Dashboard"},{value:"editor",label:"富文本编辑器"}]}/>
  </box>
  <box gap={2}>
    <label>功能要求</label>
    {#each [{id:"virtual",name:"虚拟滚动"},{id:"responsive",name:"响应式布局"},{id:"streaming",name:"流式更新"},{id:"test",name:"自动化测试"}] as f}
      <checkbox key={f.id} checked={features.includes(f.id)} onChange={v=>setFeatures(old=>v?[...old,f.id]:old.filter(x=>x!==f.id))} lineThrough={false}>{f.name}</checkbox>
    {/each}
  </box>
  {#if features.includes("virtual")}
    <box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={3} gap={1}>
      <row align="center" gap={2}>
        <icon name="info" color="info"/>
        <text weight="medium" size="sm">虚拟滚动注意事项</text>
      </row>
      <text size="sm">建议考虑动态消息高度、滚动锚点、历史消息加载与流式内容高度变化。</text>
    </box>
  {/if}
  <box gap={1}>
    <label>补充要求</label>
    <textarea rows={2} placeholder="例如：不使用第三方虚拟列表库" value={details} onChange={setDetails}/>
  </box>
  <button block onClick={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn(`请使用 ${framework} 实现${{chatbot:"Chatbot 消息列表",dashboard:"数据分析 Dashboard",editor:"富文本编辑器"}[scenario]}，要求：${features.join("、")||"基础功能"}。补充要求：${details||"代码结构清晰，关键逻辑加注释"}。`)}>生成开发方案 <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
  <caption>点击后会将当前表单状态转换为新的对话请求。</caption>
</box>
